sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English podcast.
My name is Emily.
I speak slowly and clearly to help you learn English.
Today, let's talk about a big and exciting city.
The city is called Beijing.
Beijing is the capital city of China.
It is one of the most famous cities in the world.
Let's learn more about it.
Where is Beijing?
Beijing is in the north of China.
It is a very large city.
More than 21 million people live there.
That is a lot of people.
Beijing is an old and modern city.
There are many tall buildings, cars, and busy streets, but there are also old temples, parks, and quiet places.
A city of history.
Beijing is over 3,000 years old.
It was the capital of many Chinese emperors.
A long time ago, kings and queens lived in Beijing.
One famous place is the Forbidden City.
It is in the middle of Beijing.
It was the home of Chinese emperors.
It is big and beautiful.
You can walk inside and see red walls, golden roofs, and many old rooms.
Another famous place is Tiananmen Square.
It is one of the biggest squares in the world.
Many people go there to take photos and walk around.
The Great Wall of China near Beijing.
You can see the Great Wall of China.
It is one of the most famous things in the world.
The wall is very long.
Over 21,000 kilometers.
It goes across the mountains.
You can visit the wall from Beijing by bus or car.
You can walk on the wall and see beautiful views.
It is a fun trip.
Parks and nature.
Beijing has many nice parks.
One popular park is Beihai Park.
It has a big lake and small boats.
You can walk, relax, and see flowers.
Another nice place is the Temple of Heaven.
It is a big round building.
It is very colorful.
In the past, emperors came here to pray for good weather and food.
In the morning, many people do Tai Chi in the parks.
Tai Chi is a kind of slow exercise.
It looks like a dance.
Food in Beijing.
The food in Beijing is very tasty.
One famous dish is Peking Duck.
It is a kind of roasted duck with crispy skin.
People eat it with pancakes, onions, and sweet sauce.
It is very delicious.
You can also eat dumplings, noodles, and rice dishes.
There are many small restaurants and street food places.
You can try many different things.
Do you like sweet food?
You can try Tang Hulu.
It is fruit on a stick with sugar on top.
Children love it.
Getting around Beijing is a very big city, but it is easy to travel around.
You can take the subway, a bus, or a taxi.
The subway is fast and cheap.
Signs are in Chinese and English, so it is easy for visitors.
You can also rent a bicycle or walk around the city.
Language and people in Beijing.
People speak Mandarin Chinese.
It is the official language of China.
It sounds very different from English.
Many people are learning English too, especially young people.
People in Beijing are friendly and helpful.
They like to share their culture and food.
Weather Beijing has four seasons.
Spring is warm and windy.
Summer is hot and sunny.
Autumn is cool and dry.
Winter is very cold, and sometimes it snows.
If you visit in summer, wear light clothes.
If you come in winter, bring a warm coat.
Festivals.
China has many festivals.
In Beijing, the most famous is the Spring Festival.
It is also called Chinese New Year.
People clean their homes, eat special food, and watch fireworks.
Another festival is the Mid -Autumn Festival.
People eat mooncakes and look at the moon.
It is a family holiday.
During festivals, Beijing is full of lights, colors, and music.
Beijing is a city of history, food, people, and culture.
It is very big and full of interesting things.
You can see the old and the new together.
